name: @aethelred/wallet-x402-solver
description: Concrete intent-router Solver implementation backed by the x402 facilitator protocol. Accepts PaymentIntent → produces signed EIP-3009 authorization → submits via x402Fetch → translates receipt into a Fill. First production-shape solver in the marketplace — pattern for Uniswap v3 / CoW / bespoke liquidity solvers to follow.
